title: The other you
summary: Someone has made an account pretending to be you, and he's been asking fans for money for a sick nan. A young fan's grandad has already sent him two hundred quid. A season on, he's in the stand.

ends.title: Paid him back
ends.text: Somebody pretended to be you and took a fan's grandad's money. You paid it back yourself. He spent it on two season tickets, one for her.

ends.title: Reported
ends.text: A fake you took a fan's grandad's money. You reported the account and it went. You never knew if he got his money back.

event.title: The other you
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A message to your real account from {kidfan.name}, the girl from the barrier. "My grandad sent you £200 for your nan's operation. Is she ok?" There's a screenshot. It's your photo, and not your account.

say: "He's not got much. He said you'd always been nice to me so he wanted to help. It was you, wasn't it? It had your photo."

replies.label: "It wasn't me. I'm so sorry. I'll pay him back myself."
"It wasn't me. Tell him to ring his bank and the police."

paid.text: You send her grandad two hundred quid and a signed shirt. He writes back a long letter with a lot of commas and no full stops, and it makes your day.

reported.text: She says he will. The account's gone by Friday. Two more fans message you to say they nearly sent money.

posted.text: "I will never ask you for money." Two million people see it. The account's gone by lunch.

beats.title: The police

event.title: The police
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A policewoman rings. They've found the man behind the fake account. He's nineteen and in the next town. The girl's grandad wants his two hundred back, and to meet him.

say: "Would you be there? The grandad asked for you."

go.text: A room at the police station. The lad can't look at any of you. The grandad shakes his hand anyway.

pay.text: He takes it and sends it straight back with a note: "Not yours to pay."

no.text: You let it go, and get on with your day.

beats.hint: The police have found the fake account

beats.title: The stand

event.title: The stand
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A season on. {kidfan.short} is at the rail by the tunnel with an old man in a flat cap. He's holding up a card: "I'M THE £200 GRANDAD."
{if arc.deep=='go'}Her grandad still tells the police station story.{/if}

outcomes.text: "Spent it on two season tickets," he says. "Me and her. Seemed right." She shows you hers, laminated.
"The bank never gave it back," he says, cheerfully. "Worth it for the story." You give him your shirt.
They give one back, both of them, with both hands.
He waves the card. You never find out about the money.

beats.hint: A season on, someone in the stand
